projects.name: CloudPilot AI
projects.description: Analyze, score, and optimize your Terraform infrastructure across 10 cloud providers. Point it at any Terraform or OpenTofu repo and it parses every resource, prices it across AWS, Azure, GCP, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, Scaleway, OVHcloud, Oracle, Vultr, and Linode, produces a production-readiness score, explains the evidence it used — and flags what it could not inspect.
highlights: Custom HCL2 parser — no Terraform binary required, with source file and line-number provenance.
Multi-cloud cost engine pricing the same architecture on 10 providers.
Weighted 0–100 production-readiness score across 8 dimensions with explicit evidence coverage.
Honest evidence coverage — flags modules it could not inspect instead of guessing.
FinOps dashboard with rightsizing, spot-instance opportunities, and cost outlooks.
AI-assisted analysis with a deterministic rule engine, optional LLM review, and a local risk-intelligence model.

projects.name: IBS vs NCGS
projects.description: Can gut bacteria tell irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) apart from non-celiac gluten sensitivity (NCGS)? An exploratory ML research project on public stool metagenomes (PRJNA981497, Dixit et al. 2026, mSphere), reprocessed from raw sequencing reads on free compute (Kaggle). It is exploratory, with honest limits: a small cohort (n = 28, 14 IBS vs 14 NCGS) and no external validation yet. It is not a diagnostic tool.
highlights: Resumable fastp → Bowtie2 (host read removal) → Kraken2 → Bracken pipeline built for a 12 h CPU limit, with a Snakemake workflow, Docker, tests and GitHub Actions CI.
Logistic regression on CLR-transformed abundances with nested cross-validation and a guard test against data leakage.
SHAP, DeLong and bootstrap confidence intervals, calibrated permutation tests and FDR correction.
AUC ≈ 0.8 (permutation p = 0.02); the pipeline agrees with the original paper (9 of the top 30 taxa overlap).
Less Anaerostipes in IBS (q = 0.026); Klebsiella is kept as a hypothesis, not a result.
A selection-bias trap was caught and corrected (0.95 → 0.64–0.68).
Frozen model and a pre-registered external-validation script.

projects.name: Mini ATS
projects.description: A multi-tenant applicant tracking system with a Kanban hiring pipeline, job management, and an "Assess with AI" feature that compares a candidate's CV with the job description and returns a score, strengths, gaps and a recommendation.
highlights: Kanban hiring pipeline with drag and drop, optimistic updates and keyboard accessibility.
Admin console with a "viewing as customer" mode, and filters stored in the URL.
CV upload as PDF with text extraction in the browser (pdf.js).
"Assess with AI" Supabase Edge Function using an OpenAI-compatible API (Groq).
Postgres Row Level Security per tenant, roles from app metadata, admin-only account creation server-side and a private storage bucket.
The service role key is never in the frontend.
Source code: https://github.com/fatma2708/mini-ats
